author: Rick Fritz
text:
Gene Holcombe thanks, will start with the Libre3 tomorrow, have 2 samples.

Then will try the 3+, tried the 3+ a year ago with 3 samples. and was a disaster.  First one fell off after 11 days, 2nd one stopped working after 12 days, and the 3rd one failed after 1 hour.  When the 3+ worked, results were consistently lower by 15-20% than fingersticks. 

Looking for an alternative to my current Dexcom G6.  Currently trying the Dexcom G7 and the app is flawless, but the accuracy in the first 24 hour sensor life was absolutely useless, but after then the accuracy has been spot on and very impressive.
